note: The loading stages, in the order the real job emits them. Wording is Luís's, put into present participles so a progress indicator reads at one speed. `hold` is milliseconds.
holdsAreProportional: The real job spends its time roughly 13% planning, 65% voice, 19% render, 2% mux. The holds below keep that shape, so the fake clock at least moves like the real one: the voice is the longest wait here because it is the longest wait in truth.
ideasDelayNote: How long the idea generator appears to think. Ideas that arrive instantly read as ideas that were already there, which is the opposite of a suggestion. The real generator takes 15 to 40 seconds against the model.
